Coram : ALTAMAS KABIR*, MARKANDEY KATJU
A B Service Law - Pension - Entitlement to - For employees opting for voluntary retirement under a scheme - Respondent bank employee - Applied for voluntary retirement under the c 2001 Scheme - Application was accepted and respondent was paid all retiral benefits under the Scheme - But his request to other retiral benefits not acceded to by the Bank - Held: Regulation 28 of the Pension Regulations, 1995, after amendment made provision for situations similar to the one in the instant case D - Respondent not entitled to pension as he did not complete required length of qualifying service
Decision Date : 18-12-2008 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7417/2008 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
